CustomField.formula:
/* Annual Professional Tax based on Tamil Nadu half-yearly slabs */
Round(IF( Gross_Salary__c / 2 <= 21000, 0,
IF( Gross_Salary__c / 2 <= 30000, 180 * 2,
IF( Gross_Salary__c / 2 <= 45000, 425 * 2,
IF( Gross_Salary__c / 2 <= 60000, 930 * 2,
IF( Gross_Salary__c / 2 <= 75000, 1025 * 2,
1250 * 2 ))))),0)
CustomField.label: PT (Annual)
